_doc: docs/adr/ADR-031.md, 设计修正 2, E as its corrections after the second implementation review leave it: every source file in one class (the client crate hoh-client, which must not depend on hoh-app; hoh-app's host-only files and its entry main.rs; the libraries); every place in non-test code that starts or replaces a process or makes the plain spawner, with its owner; the functions only the host's entries call; and each place a client, entry or library file writes stderr other than through the client's writer (scripts/product/spawn_scan.py).

sites.reason: the plain spawner's own definition and constructors
Direct::host's wait-only spawn and Helper::spawn (process group of its own, pidfd at once)
the client's start gate spawns through a plain spawner under its tickets (A)
`hoh __gate`, the agent start gate the host runs (ADR-022 decision 13), replaces itself with the agent
the host's agent probes and compat suite (its stop is its ProbeStop)
git_run, the host's bounded git invocation
run_tests, the project's detected test commands run once after the user confirms (docs/adr/ADR-039.md decision 8): its own process group, bounded, killed with it on the host's stop
the host's store (its WAL self-test probe)
a verification check's command, run by the host
`hoh __unit`, the installer's internal entry, asks systemctl; it registers no client signal state
compat::register, called only by tests before a host starts (ADR-030 decision 10)

stderr_sites.reason: fd 2's one descriptor (Fd2): the writer thread's, the direct write before the signal state is registered, the exit's bounded direct write after the writer ended, and the panic hook's words (ADR-031, 设计修正 2, C)
the writer's sink, made once as the signal state is registered (ADR-031, 设计修正 2, C)
the panic hook's words after the terminal's restore failed: the second written exception (C)
`hoh __host` moves its own stderr to .hoh/host.log once it is ready: the host's process, which has no client writer
probe_main, the `hoh __wal-probe` process's own diagnostics: a process of its own, which has no client writer
